sources.finding: Unity 2022.3 Linux Editor requires x64 CPU with SSE2. This aarch64 Linux host does not meet it.
Unity 6 Linux Editor also requires x64 CPU with SSE2.
Android development requires Android Build Support, SDK, NDK and JDK.
Unity Personal financial threshold is $200,000 for preceding 12 months; service providers must account for client finances. Eligibility and valid activation were not established.

no_new_cost_work_possible: Source and asset metadata inspection using Python stdlib, Node and Git.
Static consistency checks, text/JSON/YAML analysis, packaging with zip/tar and synchronization with rsync.
Procedural asset/source generation that needs only installed tools, and media conversion with ffmpeg.
Build instructions and scripts can be prepared for a separately identified existing compatible host.
no_new_cost_build_conditions: An already available compatible x64 Linux/Windows or supported macOS machine with project-matching Unity Editor, Android dependencies and valid eligible license would be needed. No such machine was identified in the inspected configuration.
Eligibility for Unity Personal is unknown; free eligibility must not be assumed for commissioned work.
No paid or nominal-free cloud resource, external CI build, trial, account, license activation or emulation was attempted.
